title: Minutes of the meeting
prompt:
Julian left a TODO note in the middle of main, and Java won't compile it.

In Java, // starts a comment that lasts to the end of the line. /* ... */ covers many lines, and /** ... */ is a documentation comment, like the one at the top.

Turn the TODO line into a comment so the program prints exactly:

Council office hours: Fri, Sat, Sun evenings
Coffee appreciation society: Mon to Thu mornings
hints: Java doesn't know what the word TODO means. Make the whole line a comment so the compiler skips it.
Change the TODO line to: // TODO confirm the society's table at Café Cache

tests.expected_stdout:
Council office hours: Fri, Sat, Sun evenings
Coffee appreciation society: Mon to Thu mornings
